name: An entity
title: Create your first *entity* and a *simple CRUD*
lede: We write a Post entity and the associated handler to expose operations to the rest of the world.

fig.text: is an entity. It describes a post. Validation, forms and APIs are read from it.
is a handler. Its public methods are operations anyone can call.
is a repository. It stores posts in memory. *PostHandler* extends it, so it already lists, reads, creates, updates and deletes.
is imported by fougere.config.ts, which then says *protocols: { rest: {} }*. Without the import, that line does not typecheck and the app refuses to start.
